description: Project workspace UI and components. Create app/projects/[agreementId]/page.tsx with tabs (Overview, Scope, Deliveries, Messages, History), responsive layouts, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support. Implement DeliveryUpload component with file validation, InspectionResults component showing pass/fail checks, ApprovalButton component for brand, ProductionPassport timeline view. Maintain existing UI patterns (glassmorphism, Tailwind, Framer Motion where appropriate).
steps: Create app/projects/[agreementId]/page.tsx: (1) Use 'use client' directive. (2) Fetch agreement data using custom hook or direct fetch in useEffect. (3) Implement Radix UI Tabs with 5 tabs: Overview, Scope, Deliveries, Messages, History. (4) Use existing Navbar component. (5) Apply responsive container (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4). (6) Handle loading and error states. (7) Verify user is participant or redirect to /dashboard with error toast.

Create app/projects/[agreementId]/components/OverviewTab.tsx: Display (1) Project status badge (Pending Creator Accept / Pending Brand Accept / Active / Completed). (2) Progress bar showing current milestone. (3) Next milestone card with deadline. (4) Quick stats: deliveries submitted, revisions requested, messages. (5) Primary action button: 'Accept Agreement' if pending user's acceptance, 'Upload Delivery' if creator in active, 'View Latest Delivery' otherwise.

Create app/projects/[agreementId]/components/ScopeTab.tsx: Display (1) Agreement version number and creation date. (2) Deliverables section from agreement.deliverables JSONB: content type, aspect ratios, duration, resolution, quantity. (3) Price and currency. (4) Milestones with deadlines from agreement.milestones JSONB. (5) Included revisions count. (6) Usage requirements from agreement.usageRequirements JSONB: license tier, model indemnity, usage regions. (7) Acceptance status: creator accepted timestamp, brand accepted timestamp, both accepted badge. (8) If both not accepted, show 'Accept Agreement' button for current user's role.

Create components/project/DeliveryUpload.tsx: (1) File input with drag-and-drop zone. (2) Validate on select: max 500MB, allowed extensions (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .jpg, .png, .webp). Show error toast if invalid. (3) Display file preview (thumbnail for images, filename for videos). (4) Show upload progress bar during upload. (5) On upload complete, show 'Inspecting...' spinner. (6) POST to /api/deliveries with FormData. (7) On success, show inspection results modal with InspectionResults component. (8) On error, show error toast with message.

Create app/projects/[agreementId]/components/DeliveriesTab.tsx: (1) Display DeliveryUpload component at top if user is creator and agreement active. (2) List all deliveries from GET /api/deliveries?agreementId=X, ordered by version DESC (newest first). (3) Each delivery card shows: version number, file name, size, upload timestamp, inspection status badge (Pass/Fail/Unsupported/Error with color coding), download button (GET /api/deliveries/[id]), approval status (if brand approved). (4) If user is brand and delivery inspection_status='pass' or has override, show ApprovalButton component. (5) Click delivery to expand and show InspectionResults component inline.

Create components/project/InspectionResults.tsx: Props {inspectionStatus, inspectionResults}. (1) Display status badge with icon: Pass (green check), Fail (red X), Unsupported (yellow warning), Error (red error). (2) Show metadata table: dimensions, aspect ratio, duration, format, codec. (3) If status='fail', show checks array in table: requirement name, expected value, actual value, passed (checkmark or X). (4) If status='unsupported' or 'error', show message from inspectionResults. (5) Style with glassmorphic card, subtle border, responsive.

Create components/project/ApprovalButton.tsx: Props {deliveryId, inspectionStatus, onApproved}. (1) If inspectionStatus='fail', show 'Approve with Override' button opening dialog with textarea for overrideReason (required). (2) If inspectionStatus='pass', show 'Approve Delivery' button with confirmation dialog including textarea for optional approvalNotes. (3) On confirm, POST to /api/deliveries/[id]/approve with body. (4) Show loading state during request. (5) On success, call onApproved callback and show success toast. (6) On error, show error toast.

Create app/projects/[agreementId]/components/MessagesTab.tsx: (1) Display message input at bottom: textarea for content, dropdown for messageType (Comment / Revision Request / Scope Change Request), conditional fields (deliveryVersion selector if revision request, proposedChanges JSON editor if scope change). (2) Send button POSTs to /api/project-messages. (3) Message list above input, scrollable, shows sender name, timestamp, message type badge, content. (4) If revision request, show linked delivery version link. (5) If scope change request, show proposed changes summary and acceptance status (Pending Creator / Pending Brand / Accepted by Both). (6) Auto-scroll to bottom on new message. (7) Distinguish current user's messages (right-aligned) from other party (left-aligned).

Create components/project/ProductionPassport.tsx: Props {passportData from GET /api/passport/[agreementId]}. (1) Display vertical timeline with events sorted by timestamp. (2) Each event: icon based on type (brief=document, proposal=handshake, delivery=upload, message=chat, approval=check), timestamp, event type label, expandable data. (3) Original brief section: campaign title, objective, budget, deadline. (4) Original proposal section: creator, price, timeline. (5) All deliveries section: version, file, inspection results, approval status. (6) All messages section: count and link to Messages tab. (7) Scope changes section if any exist. (8) Final approval section: brand approved timestamp, approval notes. (9) Review section if exists: rating, comment. (10) Export button (future: could generate PDF, for now just visual label). (11) Style with timeline connector lines, glassmorphic cards per event, responsive.
Create app/projects/[agreementId]/components/HistoryTab.tsx: Render ProductionPassport component with data from GET /api/passport/[agreementId].

Add keyboard navigation: (1) Tab key navigates between focusable elements. (2) Enter/Space activates buttons. (3) Escape closes dialogs. (4) Arrow keys navigate tabs if using Radix Tabs. (5) Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements (ring-2 ring-purple-500).

Add reduced motion support: Wrap Framer Motion animations in useReducedMotion hook check (hooks/useReducedMotion.ts already exists per context). If reduced motion preferred, disable transition animations, show static states.

Update components/layout/Navbar.tsx: Add 'Projects' link in navigation menu pointing to /projects (future: could list all user's agreements). For now, links directly to agreement when context available.
acceptance_criteria: app/projects/[agreementId]/page.tsx renders with Radix UI Tabs showing 5 tabs, responsive on mobile/tablet/desktop
Overview tab shows project status, progress bar, next milestone, quick stats, primary action button appropriate to user role and agreement state
Scope tab displays all agreement fields (deliverables, price, milestones, revisions, usage requirements, acceptance status) in readable format
DeliveryUpload component validates files client-side (size, type), shows progress during upload, displays inspection results on completion
Deliveries tab lists all versions with inspection status badges, download buttons, approval UI for brand, expandable inspection details
InspectionResults component clearly shows pass/fail/unsupported/error with metadata table and checks array for failures
ApprovalButton enforces override reason for failed deliveries, shows confirmation dialog, handles errors gracefully
Messages tab allows posting comments/revision requests/scope changes, displays chronological message history with type badges, shows scope change acceptance status
History tab renders ProductionPassport with vertical timeline, all events sorted chronologically, expandable data, original brief/proposal sections, final approval/review sections
Keyboard navigation works: Tab through elements, Enter/Space activate, Escape closes dialogs, focus indicators visible
Reduced motion respected: animations disabled when prefers-reduced-motion active, uses existing useReducedMotion hook
verification: Build check: npm run build. Expect 0 TypeScript errors.

Navigate to /projects/<valid-agreementId> in browser while logged in as creator or brand. Expect page loads, tabs render, no console errors. Test with non-participant user, expect redirect to /dashboard with error toast.

Overview tab: Verify status badge shows 'Pending Creator Accept' if creator hasn't accepted. Click 'Accept Agreement' button, verify POST to /api/agreements/[id]/accept succeeds, status updates to 'Pending Brand Accept' or 'Active' depending on other party's status.
Scope tab: Verify all agreement fields displayed correctly. If pending acceptance, verify 'Accept Agreement' button appears and functions.

Deliveries tab (creator): Click 'Upload Delivery' in DeliveryUpload component, select valid mp4 file <500MB. Verify progress bar shows, upload completes, inspection runs, results modal appears showing inspection status and checks. Dismiss modal, verify delivery card appears in list with correct version number, file name, inspection status badge.

Deliveries tab (brand): Find delivery with inspection_status='pass'. Click ApprovalButton, enter optional approval notes, confirm. Verify POST to /api/deliveries/[id]/approve succeeds, delivery shows 'Approved by Brand' badge with timestamp. Test with failed delivery, verify override reason required, can approve with reason.

Messages tab: Type comment 'Great work!', select messageType='Comment', send. Verify appears in message list immediately, POST to /api/project-messages succeeds. Test revision request with deliveryVersion selector. Test scope change request with proposedChanges input (JSON format).

History tab: Verify timeline renders with all events (brief created, proposal accepted, agreement created, deliveries, messages, approvals). Expand events, verify data displays correctly. Check chronological order.

Keyboard navigation: Press Tab repeatedly, verify focus moves through tabs, buttons, inputs. Press Enter on focused button, verify activates. Press Escape in open dialog, verify closes. Verify focus indicators visible (purple ring).
Reduced motion: Open browser DevTools, toggle prefers-reduced-motion in Rendering settings. Reload page, verify animations disabled, content still accessible and functional.
